NATIONAL CC CHAMPS. STAUNTON PARK, HAVANT 8 MAR 1997

photos.c: Above: "Out of Africa". A couple of miles into the National Junior Cross Country Championships at Parliament Hill and Belgrave's Kaessa Tadesse leads Coventry Godiva's Stefan White (186), the eventual winner , Blackheath's Tim Dickinson (behind), who ended up 4th, and 'Southern' winner Spencer Barden (242) of GEC Avionics, 3rd.
Halfway. Tim Dickinson (Blackheath) and Kaessa Tadesse run shoulder to shoulder with Spencer Barden (GEC Avionics) and Stefan White (Coventry Godiva) right on their tails.
